record.what_it_does: Bright Data provides proxy infrastructure and web-scraping/data-collection APIs (Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Datasets, Scraping Browser) that let developers programmatically fetch and unblock public web data.
record.auth_notes: Bright Data issues an account-level 'API token' (a static API key) automatically on signup, used as a Bearer token in the Authorization header for all REST API products (Datasets, Web Scraper API, Account Management). Proxy products (residential/datacenter proxy zones) instead use zone username/password credentials for proxy authentication rather than the API token, but the documented API layer uses Bearer token auth. No OAuth2 flow for third-party/multi-tenant delegation is documented.
record.access_notes: Signup is immediate and self-serve; the API token is auto-generated at account creation, and Web Unlocker/MCP include a 5,000-request free monthly tier with 'No credit card required.' Some products (Datasets marketplace premium data, Scale/Enterprise tiers) require paid plans, but basic API access to build a toolkit is free.

record.open_questions: No OAuth2 delegated-auth flow is documented, so a multi-tenant agent toolkit would need to store each end-user's Bright Data API token directly rather than using a standard OAuth redirect; unclear if Bright Data offers a partner/OAuth program for this use case.
